notes.subject: arrows drunk with blood
notes.rationale: ashkir — 'make drunk/saturate'; kept the drinking picture, arrows soaked in blood.

notes.subject: פרעות
notes.rationale: from פרע (let hair hang loose): KJV 'beginning of revenges' (repointed), JPS 'long-haired heads', ASV 'leaders'; rendered 'leaders with unshorn hair'.

notes.subject: מדם ... מדם
notes.rationale: repetition of 'from blood' frames the verse, kept in both places.

translation: Bai mi dringim planti ol aro bilong mi long blut, na bainat bilong mi bai kaikai mit — long blut bilong ol man ol i wundim ol i dai, na bilong ol kalabus — i kamap long het bilong ol bikman ol i no trimim het, bilong ol birua.

tokens.gloss: ol man ol i wundim ol i dai
ol bikman ol i no trimim het
